title: Concurrent edits to one issue produce git merge conflicts in its JSON with no Kanbus way to resolve them
description: Found while testing the shared-repository setup. Two clones change the same issue between pushes (one changes status, one adds a comment); git pull stops with a content conflict in project/issues/<id>.json. Agents are told never to edit issue JSON, so the only recovery is git checkout --theirs and redoing the change, which is now documented in docs/getting-started/cloud-files.md. A git merge driver or a kbs resolve command that merges field-level changes and comment lists would remove this.
